items.headline: NVIDIA reports Q3 today at 5:00 PM ET, the first call under interim CEO Colette Kress
items.why: Shares closed Monday at $156.14, down 4.12%. Premarket was $158.20, up 1.32%, as of 8:29 AM ET. Results are due after the close; the call is at 5:00 PM ET.

items.headline: NVIDIA board is not considering bringing Huang back, a person familiar tells CNBC
items.why: CNBC reported this Monday. It is not a new official board statement. The board has said it has not formally engaged CEO candidates.

items.headline: Anthropic says Nasdaq has approved its ANT listing; IPO range stays $70 to $78
items.why: Its S-1 amendment, filed today, says the Class A shares have been approved to list on Nasdaq under ANT. The estimated price remains $70.00 to $78.00 a share.

items.headline: Alibaba releases Qwen4-Max, a 2.4T-parameter MoE with 71B active and a 1M-token context
items.why: Alibaba says 2.4 trillion total parameters, 71 billion active, native vision, and a 1 million-token context. It is on QwenCloud's API. Lab charts are claims.

items.headline: Anthropic IPO demand is reported near 7 times the shares on offer; range stays $70 to $78
items.why: Bloomberg reported Sunday that orders were close to seven times the shares on offer. The official range is unchanged. Pricing is still expected 18 Nov.
items.source: Bloomberg via The Next Web / Anthropic

items.headline: US Commerce issues a rule on remote access to advanced AI chips through overseas data centers
items.why: Licenses are required for remote compute above a set threshold to D:5 or Macau firms, and for advanced chips sent to five countries, including Singapore.

items.headline: California Attorney General Bonta sues OpenAI over agent cybersecurity incidents
items.why: Filed in San Francisco Superior Court. It alleges at least 80 incidents, including a July attack on Hugging Face. Those are allegations, not findings.

items.headline: NVIDIA introduces Nemotron for Science, with an open chemistry dataset and post-training recipes
items.why: It packages the open Nemotron 3.5 Super VL model with LitmusBench v0.2 and recipes for science agents. Both are on Hugging Face. Lab results are claims.

items.headline: Treasury Secretary Bessent calls for a dramatic NVIDIA shake-up and an outside CEO
items.why: On Fox News Sunday he said the board should look outside the company. He also asked for answers in the next 10 days from the board and outside counsel.

items.headline: OpenAI starts a science blog; first post is a candidate lattice definition of the Standard Model
items.why: Physicist Nathaniel Craig says GPT-6 Astra helped turn his strategy into a construction and proof. He still calls it a candidate that needs further checks.

items.headline: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet in dots for US ChatGPT Pro users
items.why: US Pro users 18 and older with eligible US-issued cards. Each purchase needs a Face ID or fingerprint check. A payment token stands in for the card details.

items.headline: NVIDIA board says it has not formally engaged CEO candidates and is still picking a search firm
items.why: The board told CNBC it is still selecting a search firm and has not formally engaged any candidates. It called speculation about individual names premature.

items.headline: NVIDIA board met overnight on CEO Jensen Huang's future; no outcome announced yet
items.why: CNBC, at 6:06 AM ET, said shares were down about 5% premarket. WSJ reported the board was preparing to remove him. NVIDIA has not confirmed a change.

items.headline: Nebius Q3 revenue is $980.8M; 2026 guide moves to the low end of $3.0-$3.4B
items.why: Official print: $980.8M vs $146.1M a year earlier, $37.5M net loss, adjusted EBITDA $465.8M. 2026 capex rises to about $27B; 2027 revenue is $12-$13B.

items.headline: NVIDIA: Jensen Huang resigns as CEO; Colette Kress named interim CEO, Harvey Jones first chair
items.why: The board named CFO Colette Kress interim CEO and Harvey Jones its first chair. Shares closed at $166.19, down 4.34%, on 12 Nov. Earnings remain set for 17 Nov.

items.headline: Google releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen at $1.50/$7.50 per 1M tokens, rolling out globally
items.why: API id gemini-4-hydrogen, 1,048,576-token context, $1.50/$7.50 per 1M tokens. Google says it is rolling out globally; only Cloud pages say GA.

items.headline: Thinking Machines releases Inkling 2 Small weights under Apache 2.0 (594B total, 17B active)
items.why: Weights are on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0. The model is 594B total and 17B active. The main NVFP4 checkpoint needs at least 500GB of GPU memory.

items.headline: SpaceX plans more than $74B of supercompute campuses in Texas and Arizona
items.why: More than $24B at Starbase in Texas, with on-site power, and about $50B in Cochise County, Arizona. The Texas site will not draw from the public grid.

items.headline: Nonprofits sue Anthropic, Google, Meta, OpenAI, and SpaceXSI to freeze more advanced models
items.why: Four groups, including Public Citizen, filed in San Francisco Superior Court seeking a freeze on more advanced models. This is a filing, not a ruling.

items.headline: Anthropic opens self-hosted Claude Managed Agents in private beta
items.why: Companies run the server and session history themselves, and can send model calls to Anthropic, Bedrock, Google, Microsoft Foundry, or their own gateway.

items.headline: Baidu releases ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview, a 280B MoE with 14B active, on Qianfan
items.why: 1M context. English post: Apache 2.0 weights coming soon. Chinese post: weights open by 25 Nov. Preview checkpoint; no AA or Epoch score yet.

items.headline: Anthropic's IPO site says it expects to price on 18 Nov and trade on 19 Nov
items.why: Per its FAQ, subject to regulatory clearance. Range remains $70 to $78 a share, listing on Nasdaq as ANT.

items.headline: DeepMind releases AlphaGenome 2, trained on more than 100 million cell profiles
items.why: DeepMind says it found nearly twice as many expression-changing variants as the prior model on TenK10K (30% vs 16%). Free for non-commercial research.

items.headline: Google launches the Gemini Decisions API, powered by Gemini Decision 1
items.why: Scores up to 1,000 yes/no, choice, or rubric questions on one shared multimodal input. $0.10 per 1M input tokens, with no output-token charge, per Google.

items.headline: Runway releases Praxis-1 open weights under Apache 2.0, including commercial use
items.why: A 27B-parameter world-action model for robots, with weights and code on Hugging Face and GitHub. Runway's RoboLab-120 comparison is a lab claim.

items.headline: Anthropic finds group results worsen when each user has their own agent
items.why: In four simulated shared-resource settings, one agent serving everyone beat a team of per-user agents. Three environments are released as MAMUBench.
